answer: A Sybil island must fund n identities with collateral c and quadratic slashing lambda n^2, so marginal attack cost dC/dn equals c plus 2 lambda n. Extracted value per identity is bounded by V/n; if security sets c plus 2 lambda n above V/n, the cost curve passes the zenith of all extractable rent before quill capital can break consensus, making attacks uneconomic.
